description.value: The Quarterdeck Pub is part of the Quarterdeck Resort & Marina, a full-service oceanfront complex on Hardy Bay at the northern tip of Vancouver Island. Dining is anchored by the independently operated Oceanside Cantina, offering Mexican-inspired cuisine indoors and on a scenic oceanside patio, alongside the resort pub. Port Hardy is a key gateway for cyclists finishing northern Vancouver Island tours, and the resort sits just a short walk from downtown.

address.value: 6555 Hardy Bay Road, Port Hardy, BC V0N 2P0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this node as amenity=pub under the name 'Quarterdeck Pub'; the website at quarterdeckresort.net confirms an active pub/restaurant operates as part of the Quarterdeck Resort & Marina at 6555 Hardy Bay Road, Port Hardy. The amenities page and front page both explicitly confirm complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the property, and the Marina & Dining subpage lists a takeout menu for the Oceanside Cantina. No bike-specific amenities (racks, pumps, e-bike charging, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name 'Quarterdeck Pub' understates the business, which operates as 'Quarterdeck Resort & Marina' with the pub component labelled 'Quarterdeck Restaurant and Pub' on the website; primary dining is the independently operated Oceanside Cantina.
OSM record carries no address or phone; all contact details sourced from website. Pub-specific phone (+1-236-427-3946) used as primary contact since OSM has nothing to compare against.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active pub and restaurant at a full-service oceanfront resort in Port Hardy, a key waypoint for cyclists completing northern Vancouver Island tours; food service, takeout, and Wi-Fi confirmed.

wow_evidence: full-service oceanfront complex on Hardy Bay at the northern tip of Vancouver Island
